correctness.rationale: Centering at the saddle gives the projection-free matrix \(M=\begin{pmatrix}1&\tau\\-\sigma&1-\tau\sigma\end{pmatrix}\). Direct multiplication verifies \(M^{\mathsf T}QM=Q\) for \(Q=\begin{pmatrix}\sigma&\tau\sigma/2\\\tau\sigma/2&\tau\end{pmatrix}\), whose determinant is \(\tau\sigma(1-\tau\sigma/4)>0\) exactly when \(\tau\sigma<4\). Completing squares on \(u=-1\) and \(v=-1\) gives boundary minima \(\sigma(1-\tau\sigma/4)\) and \(\tau(1-\tau\sigma/4)\), so the stated \(c_*\) is exactly the largest strict invariant-energy sublevel contained in the positive orthant. Since the linear candidate preserves energy, induction proves projections never activate. At \(\tau\sigma=4\sin^2(\pi/m)\), the characteristic roots are the primitive pair \(e^{\pm2\pi i/m}\), so every nonzero orbit in the sublevel has exact period \(m\). The inspected checker independently reproduces these identities; finite resonant samples are corroboration only.
